usage: 一個 (jat1 go3) is used as a measure word to count singular items, often meaning "one" or "a".
It can function as a standalone noun phrase to refer to a single object or unit.
You can use 一個 before nouns to specify the quantity of one item in a casual conversation.
In questions, 一個 can be used to ask about the quantity of something, e.g., how many items.
It commonly appears in everyday speech when ordering or talking about discrete objects.
